newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis up, corn, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis up, corn, wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis values moved higher in reaction to the steep drop in CBOT soybean futures Tuesday, export dealers said.
However, dealers said soybean FOB values were difficult to define because the drop in the futures had many shippers reluctant to quote FOB values.
Corn and winter wheat values were mostly unchanged. Soft red winter wheat sales slowed when recent rains halted the Midwest harvest. Dealers said SRW wheat harvest should resume Wednesday.
